blocks.title: Thermoregulation
blocks.text: Thermoregulation woh homeostatic amal hai jis se jaandar bahar ka darja-e-hararat kuch bhi ho apna andaruni darja-e-hararat qabil-e-bardasht had mein rakhte hain.

Yeh is liye ahem hai ke enzymes ek behtareen darja-e-hararat par sab se achha kaam karte hain: is se kam par enzyme aur substrate ke takrao aur metabolism ki raftar girti hai; is se bohat zyada par enzymes denature ho kar hamesha ke liye kaam chhor dete hain. Cell ki jhilliyan bhi hassas hain: garmi un ki chunida guzar-gahi (selective permeability) khatam kar sakti aur thand unhein sakht aur bhurbhura kar sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: Thermoregulation ki tareef kijiye aur iski zaroorat samjhaiye.
blocks.explanation: Yeh jism ka darja-e-hararat mehfooz had mein rakhta hai; zaroori is liye ke enzymes thand mein sust aur zyada garmi mein denature hote hain, aur jhilliyan thand mein bhurbhuri aur garmi mein risne wali ho jati hain.

items: Thermoregulation darja-e-hararat had mein rakh kar enzymes aur jhilliyon ko bachata hai.
